gateway_id.description: Identifier for the OHTTP Gateway / PBB intake front-end.

relay_id.description: Optional identifier for the selected relay (may be omitted in privacy-sensitive logs).

payload_b64.description: Base64 of the inner request body (e.g., BallotSubmission JSON). For cover traffic, may be random bytes.

padding_len.description: Number of padding bytes added to reach bucket size.

bucket_size.description: Target envelope bucket size in bytes.

nonce.description: Client-generated nonce to prevent replay / correlation.

client_hint.description: Optional coarse hint (e.g., 'android', 'ios', 'desktop'); MUST NOT include unique fingerprinting data.
